failure_slots: One int32 device flag for each distinct source_id, in ascending source_id order; host clears and reads all flags.
alias_policy: Incoming overwritten output cotangents, outgoing input cotangents, immutable seed snapshots and failure buffers are disjoint. Outside-mask seed slots stay unchanged.
reverse_reduction: One owner per cell and one per level; all duplicate source, density, velocity, residual, spacing and timestep cotangent contributions accumulate in fixed-order float64 and round once at the float32 destination (COMMON-AD section 40).
admission: dimensions and index products must fit signed i32; all buffers contiguous, disjoint and sized to shapes; cell and topology indices valid; ntracers,nlev,ncells positive when used.

launch_abi.branch_record_status: Both derivative entries re-execute the original per-column predicates; uint32[25][2]. Each upper and lower residual comparison has its own slot. Branch-side proofs pending.
launch_abi.failure_layout_status: int32 device slots per COMMON-AD section 35; host creates the ABI-v1 failure record.
launch_abi.l4_speed: ad/window-L4-speed: reverse entries ['l4_main', 'l4_rdzw_terms', 'l4_rdzw_sum', 'l4_dt_partial', 'l4_dt_reduce'] replace the reference single reverse entry; tangent unchanged; see phys/l4speed/README.md

directional_polynomial.scope: Only the historical branch-stable Taylor direction: source_old, rho_old and high_vertical scale by 1.5 times their captured values; dt, vertical_velocity and rdzw have zero direction. All six remain active in the pair and in per-field dot tests.

tangent_precision: Each tangent and reverse contribution and internal residual accumulation is evaluated in f64 from f32 inputs using IEEE subnormal decode and rounded once at each public f32 output using IEEE subnormal pack.

seed_clearing.written_slots: every mass, vertical_residual, scale_in and scale_out index covered by the forward launch
seed_clearing.buffers: incoming inout and outgoing input cotangent are disjoint
